The '''assault on Mon Gazza''' was an operation undertaken on [[Mon Gazza/Legends|Mon Gazza]] by [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] agents [[Wheel (SIS)|Wheel]] and [[Saber (Twi'lek)|Saber]] in [[3642 BBY]]. It was part of [[Ardun Kothe]]'s plan to gain access to the [[Shadow Arsenal]] on [[Quesh]].
